outputs.explanation: Panels Ai–ii show representative time-lapse phase-contrast images of a single mock-treated and a single saccharin-treated cell/microcolony illustrating bulge formation and lysis. No statement in the caption for this panel gives the number of independent time-lapse recordings/experiments performed or the type of replicate (biological vs. technical), so the reliability/reproducibility of the depicted phenomenon cannot be assessed from the legend.

Panel B shows a time course of phase-contrast/eCFP-FtsZ/NAO images at 0, 60 and 90 min after saccharin treatment. The caption describes methodology (staining, strain used) but does not state how many independent experiments or biological/technical replicates these representative images were drawn from.

replicate_statements: The images shown are representative examples from a minimum of three biological replicates.
outputs.explanation: The caption explicitly states that the representative time-lapse images in panel C come from a minimum of three biological replicates, satisfying both the number and type of replicate reporting.
